_about: Pictures used by the READMEs and docs. Taken on a throwaway test server with a scripted model (no real model or data), signed in as the example user Alex. test/phase114d.test.ts checks every referenced picture is listed here, exists and stays small.
method: Throwaway server from the 2.80.0 source (fresh SARA_DATA, deleted afterwards), a scripted OpenAI/Ollama-compatible model on 127.0.0.1 standing in for Ollama on this computer, made-up data for the example user Alex (a habit-tracker workspace with 6 real node --test tests, a made-up book-club PDF); the default Night look; 1440x900 desktop (dialogs cropped to the dialog), 390x844 phone at 2x; WebP quality 82.
